name: @theopentranscribe/provider-config
description: Shared server-only managed provider-configuration primitives (env > managed > unconfigured resolution, atomic managed-config persistence) for the OpenAI API CONFIGURATION-auth credential. Consumed by packages/web (Configure/Replace/Remove + status) and packages/runner (per-job fresh credential resolution). Owns CONFIGURATION-auth state only -- does not own any future CONNECTED_ACCOUNT/OAuth lifecycle.
